ResearchProjectDef.label: wraith biological augmentation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow stable symbiotic organs that can be surgically integrated into ordinary humanlike bodies. These modifications borrow from Wraith reflexes, metabolism and regeneration without turning the recipient into a Wraith.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Asuran augmentation lattices
ResearchProjectDef.description: Miniaturise Asuran motor, sensor, autonomic and repair systems into surgically implantable lattices suitable for ordinary humanlike bodies.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sovereign neural augmentation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Combine Asuran neural architecture, recovered Ancient command theory and Replicator suppression research into a rare implantable command lattice. The result can interface with Ancient control chairs and issue bounded one-target Replicator directives, but it does not reproduce a true Replicator Queen.
